slots.name: students at grade level
slots.sentence: In fact, in a recent study of a live, virtual HDT model implemented across 13 Massachusetts school districts, one of us (Neitzel) found that 85% of tutored 1st graders who mastered foundational skills were still at grade level at the end of 2nd grade.

slots.name: study districts
slots.sentence: In a study of a reading tutoring program implemented across 13 districts and 46 schools, one of us (Neitzel) found that effective implementation systems facilitated regular collaboration between providers, districts, and schools to identify and address ongoing challenges.
